title: Nifty AI Policy Document
description: Schema for the central Nifty AI governance policy document. Enforced at the tool-call boundary in OpenCode plugin and Copilot MCP server.

version.description: Schema version. Increment only on breaking changes.

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for this policy document.

effective_date.description: Date from which this policy version is active (YYYY-MM-DD).

default_effect.description: Effect applied when no rule matches. Use 'deny' for zero-trust posture.

rules.description: Ordered list of rules. First matching deny wins.

id.description: Stable identifier for this rule; used in audit logs and error messages.

action.description: Exact tool name or glob pattern. '*' matches within a segment, '**' matches any. Examples: 'nifty_delete_*', 'nifty_update_task'.

effect.description: Whether to allow or deny matching calls. Deny overrides allow.

condition.description: Optional argument-level guard. Rule only fires when condition is met.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation surfaced in the policy violation error and audit log.

_note.description: Internal annotation; not surfaced in errors or audit logs.

op.description: Comparison operator. count_gt / count_lte operate on array length.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type must match the arg and op.
